comments.author: CuriousVoidling
comments.body_html:
I’ve completed a quick run of the map and so far it is incompatible with a number of mods - mostly AI and graphics mods. Although, from what I’ve seen, it’s not like the map itself is broken, but rather those mods just don’t know the map exists and can’t handle edge case like this (big props to the author for amazing map port). I believe this is an easy fix so not all is lost.

So far, I’ve disabled the following mods from my list in order for me to load into the map:

  • SAIN

SAIN will cause the first “infinite loading/join raid screen” as it generates the necessary files for the unknown bot types, which are Wedge and Black Div, which are not known to SAIN by default. This is the same thing as when you add custom bots to your SPT for the first time and the game refuses to load into main menu at first but subsequent launches will be fine.

After that, the subsequent attempt to load into the map will be “’Suburbs’ was not present in the dictionary” error. I believe this is to do “Suburbs” map is not present in SAIN’s known maps and there is no default parameters to fall back to, so it just throw an error. SAIN actually works, but Black Div. are not using SAIN’s brain for some reason - they are using BSG layers so these new layers might be overriding SAIN’s. So for now only Rogues and Knight will be SAIN (getting chased by Knight in such a tight space is pretty cool compared to vanilla’s braindead turret brain).

  • Acid’s Bot Placement System (ABPS) and Acid’s Progressive Bot System (APBS)

Same as SAIN, both mods don’t seem to know either what these bots are or what the map is, or both, which results in “Failed to generate bot …” error in the server console.

  • ORBIT

ORBIT is preemptively disabled because SAIN is not present. There’s no way to tell if it will cause the crash or not at the moment. ORBIT will throw “’Suburbs’ was not present in the dictionary” error and prevents you from loading into the map.

  • Graphics mods that I use but have them disabled for this map:
    • AO Replacer
    • Cloud Six
    • Smajlec’s Lights
    • Better Night Skies
    • Hollywood FX

One of (if not all) of these mods will cause the black screen after you successfully load into Icebreaker. You will hear the ambient noises and, if you have BotDebug, see bots moving around, but your screen will be blacked and have severe ghosting for the UI elements. Probably the same case as SAIN: don’t know what this map is, so error it is.

  • Bosses Have Lega Medals / GP coins

I just want to mention that I preemptively disabled these mods, just in case. I don’t think they will cause any issues, though.

Keep in mind that, like previously mentioned, I’ve yet to nail down to each individual mod. I just disabled a group of mods I suspected might cause issues. Any mods not mentioned here may or may not cause further issues, or I just don’t use them so I can’t possibly tell if they will result in any trouble or not.

Just FYI, I was able to access the map by creating a new dev account, which comes with every quest completed and ready for turn-in. Then I just turned in all the “Boreas” quests at Mechanic, and ran a quick raid in Woods to turn in BTR quests. I cannot yet confirm if doing the quest line normally (with either fresh or existing standard accounts) will work as expected or not.

Edit: formatting, additional info, typos.
